source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 5 (PDF 64-75), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Code Testing and Debugging) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Name four topics of testing and debugging that this chapter covers.
(Is chapter mein testing aur debugging ke kaun se chaar mauzoo shamil hain? Naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 1. Python ke unittest aur pytest se unit testing. 2. Breakpoints, watch expressions aur step-by-step debugging. 3. Exception handling, kai qism ki exceptions samet. 4. Bottlenecks dhoondne ke liye profiling aur optimization.

book_ref.quote: They will understand the importance of testing for creating reliable applications

blocks.prompt:
2 How are advanced testing and debugging techniques more than basic error fixing?
(Advanced testing aur debugging techniques bunyadi ghalti theek karne se zyada kaise hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bunyadi ghalti theek karne se aage ja kar program ka miyar yaqeeni banati hain: chhupe masail dhoondti hain jo kaam par asar dal sakte hain, performance aur user ki tasalli barhati hain aur aage maintenance aasan karti hain.

book_ref.quote: These techniques identify hidden problems that may affect functionality.

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between testing and debugging.
(Testing aur debugging mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Debugging locates the cause of errors and fixes them efficiently.

rows: Program check karti hai ke woh sahi chale aur mutawaqqa output de.
Program ki ghaltiyan (bugs) dhoond kar theek karti hai.
Software release se pehle ghaltiyon ka pata lagati hai.
Ghaltiyon ki wajah dhoond kar unhein theek karti hai.
Baqaida testing achanak nakami se bachati hai.
Breakpoints, watches aur step-by-step jaise tools istemal karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 How does testing help when a programmer changes existing code?
(Jab programmer pehle se likha code badalta hai to testing kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tests dobara chalane se pata chalta hai ke tabdeeli ne purane features kharab nahin kiye aur sab functions ab bhi sahi nateeja dete hain; is se crash ya ghalat output ka khatra kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It also helps verify that changes do not break existing features.

blocks.prompt:
5 Identify the type of error and correct the statement:

print("Total marks" 450)
(Error ki qism pehchanein aur statement durust karein:

print("Total marks" 450))
blocks.explanation:
Syntax error: code Python ke usool par nahin (do values ke darmiyan comma ghaib hai), is liye Python ise chalata nahin.
Durust: print("Total marks", 450)
Output: Total marks 450

book_ref.quote: Syntax errors occur when code does not follow language rules.

blocks.prompt:
6 Find the error in this program and correct it:

length = 5
width = 3
area = length + width
print(area)
(Is program ki ghalti dhoondein aur durust karein:

length = 5
width = 3
area = length + width
print(area))
blocks.explanation:
Yeh logic error hai: program chalta hai magar 8 print karta hai jo ghalat area hai, kyunke yeh zarb ki jagah jama karta hai.
Durust: area = length * width, jo 15 print karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Logic errors happen when the program produces incorrect results.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a runtime error? What happens when this program runs?

total = 900
count = 0
print(total / count)
(Runtime error kya hai? Yeh program chalne par kya hota hai?

total = 900
count = 0
print(total / count))
blocks.explanation:
Runtime error program chalte waqt aata hai, chahe code usoolon ke mutabiq ho. Yahan zero se taqseem program ko is error par rok deti hai:
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

book_ref.quote: Runtime errors appear while the program is running.

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between a syntax error and a logic error.
(Syntax error aur logic error mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono errors ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Syntax errors occur when code does not follow language rules.

rows: Jab code zaban ke usool par na ho.
Jab program ghalat nateeja de.
Program chalta hi nahin.
Program chalta hai magar output ghalat hota hai.
Misal: print("Total marks" 450) (comma ghaib).
Misal: length * width ki jagah area = length + width.

blocks.prompt:
9 Why should unit test cases be clear and simple? What does each unit test check?
(Unit test cases saaf aur saade kyun hone chahiyein? Har unit test kya check karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har unit test check karta hai ke aik component (jaise function) mutawaqqa output deta hai. Saaf aur saade test cases code ka bharosa barhate hain, kyunke har test saaf batata hai ke kaun sa hissa fail hua.

book_ref.quote: Writing clear and simple test cases improves code reliability.

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between the unittest and pytest modules.
(unittest aur pytest modules mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono testing modules ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Pytest is an external module that simplifies writing and running tests.

rows: Python mein pehle se shamil.
External module.
Test cases banane ka framework deta hai, test case classes ke saath.
Tests likhna aur chalana aasan; test case classes ya boilerplate code nahin.
Tests test case classes ke andar likhe jate hain.
Tests saade functions hain jo assert istemal karte hain; command line par pytest chala kar chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
11 Write a pytest test function that checks a function subtract(a, b) with the inputs 9 and 4.
(Aik pytest test function likhein jo function subtract(a, b) ko inputs 9 aur 4 ke saath check kare.)

book_ref.quote: For example, a calculator function can be tested for addition and subtraction results.

blocks.explanation: assert check karta hai ke output sahi hai; shart False ho to test fail hota hai. Yahan multiply(2, 3) 5 deta hai, 6 nahin, is liye pytest batata hai: 1 failed (test_multiply mein AssertionError).

book_ref.quote: The tests are written as simple functions, and assert is used to check if the output is correct.

blocks.prompt:
13 How are pytest tests run, and how does pytest know which functions are tests?
(pytest tests kaise chalte hain aur pytest ko kaise pata chalta hai ke kaun se functions tests hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jis folder mein test file hai wahan command line khol kar pytest chalayein. Test functions aam tor par test_ se shuru hote hain aur pytest unhein khud dhoond kar chalata hai.

book_ref.quote: To run the tests, simply execute pytest in the command line in the directory where the file is located.

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is automated, repeated test execution useful?
(Automated aur baar baar test chalana kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Python tests khud chala kar failures ya errors batata hai. Baar baar testing yaqeeni banati hai ke code ki tabdeeli purana kaam kharab na kare, aur automation waqt bachati aur durustagi barhati hai.

book_ref.quote: Automated test execution saves time and improves accuracy in development.

blocks.prompt:
15 Differentiate between a breakpoint and a watch expression.
(Breakpoint aur watch expression mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono debugging tools ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Breakpoints and watches are tools used in debugging to analyze program behavior.

rows: Aik nishan jo chuni hui code line par program rokta hai.
Program chalte waqt kisi variable ya expression ki value dekhti rehti hai.
Pohanchne par program rukta hai aur halat dekhi ja sakti hai.
Value badalne par khud update hoti hai.
PyCharm mein margin ke line number par click se lagta hai.
IDE mein kisi variable, jaise radius, ke liye lagai jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
16 What happens when a running program reaches a breakpoint?
(Chalta hua program breakpoint par pohanche to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Program us line par ruk jata hai aur us ki maujooda halat, maslan variables ki values, dekhi ja sakti hai; phir program aage chalaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: When the program reaches a breakpoint, execution stops, and the current state can be examined.

blocks.prompt:
17 Why are breakpoints useful in a long program?
(Lambe program mein breakpoints kyun mufeed hain?)
blocks.explanation: Breakpoints poora program aik saath chalaye baghair code ke khaas hisson par tawajjo dene dete hain; programmer wahin rokta hai jahan masla lagta hai aur wahan ka data dekhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Breakpoints help focus on specific sections of code without running the entire program.

blocks.prompt:
18 In the chapter's calculate_area program (radius 5, then radius 10), what does a watch on radius show, and what does the program print?
(Chapter ke calculate_area program (pehle radius 5, phir 10) mein radius ki watch kya dikhati hai aur program kya print karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Watch dikhati hai ke program chalte waqt radius 5 se 10 ho jata hai. Program yeh print karta hai:
Area of circle: 78.5
Area of circle: 314.0

book_ref.quote: When you run the debugger, watch expressions will display how the value of radius changes as the program runs.

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between Step Into and Step Over.
(Step Into aur Step Over mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono stepping commands ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Step Over: Execute the current line and move to the next one without going inside any functions.

rows: Function ke andar ja kar dikhata hai ke woh kaise kaam karta hai.
Maujooda line chala kar agli line par jata hai.
Misal: calculate_area() mein step into kar ke dekhein ke area kaise banta hai.
Kisi function ke andar nahin jata; bulaya gaya function phir bhi chalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 What does the Continue command do during debugging?
(Debugging ke dauran Continue command kya karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Program rukne ke baad Continue use dobara chalata hai aur agle breakpoint tak le jata hai, jahan woh phir ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Continue: Continue the execution until the next breakpoint.

blocks.prompt:
21 In the chapter's database example, what are the roles of commit() and rollback()?
(Chapter ki database misal mein commit() aur rollback() ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: commit() sahi data database mein save karta hai (data ki durustagi yaqeeni). rollback() error aane par except block mein tabdeeliyan wapas le leta hai.

book_ref.quote: commit() → saves correct data (ensures integrity)

blocks.prompt:
22 Why is the finally block used in the database example?
(Database misal mein finally block kyun istemal hua hai?)
blocks.explanation: finally block error ho ya na ho, har haal mein chalta hai, is liye yeh har surat mein database connection mehfooz tareeqe se band karta hai (aur Connection closed print karta hai).

book_ref.quote: finally → safely closes the database

blocks.prompt:
23 Write the output of the following code:

try:
    marks = int("ninety")
    print("Marks:", marks)
except ValueError:
    print("Please enter digits")
finally:
    print("Thank you")
(Neeche diye gaye code ka output likhein:

try:
    marks = int("ninety")
    print("Marks:", marks)
except ValueError:
    print("Please enter digits")
finally:
    print("Thank you"))
blocks.explanation:
Please enter digits
Thank you

int("ninety") ValueError deta hai, is liye Marks: print nahin hota; except error sambhalta hai aur finally hamesha chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: try-except → handles errors and prevents crashes

blocks.prompt:
24 What happens to a program when an error occurs without exception handling, and what does exception handling change?
(Exception handling ke baghair error aaye to program ka kya hota hai, aur exception handling kya badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Exception handling ke baghair program error par crash ho jata hai (achanak ruk jata hai). Exception handling se error pakda jata hai, program tameez se jawab deta hai (maslan message dikhata hai) aur chalta rehta hai; is se bharosa aur user ka tajurba behtar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Exception handling helps programs manage unexpected problems without stopping suddenly.

blocks.explanation:
except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
Output: Invalid value (int("7") theek chalta hai, magar 7 / 0 ZeroDivisionError deta hai jo yeh clause pakad leta hai).

book_ref.quote: Python allows catching multiple exceptions in one try–except block.

blocks.explanation:
5.0
Cannot divide by zero
Enter a number

Har exception ki qism ka apna except block aur apna jawab hai.

book_ref.quote: Each exception type can be handled with a specific response.

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between profiling and optimization.
(Profiling aur optimization mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono techniques ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Profiling and optimization help improve the speed and efficiency of a program.

rows: Napti hai ke code ka har hissa kitna waqt aur resources leta hai.
Sust ya bhari hisson ko tez banati hai.
Dhoondti hai ke code ke kaun se hisse zyada waqt lete hain (bottlenecks).
Code ko behtar karti hai taake tez chale, kam resources le ya zyada efficient ho.
Tools: cProfile aur timeit.
Tareeqe: behtar algorithms, ghair zaroori operations kam, efficient data structures.

blocks.explanation: Bahar wale loop ki 500 baar mein se har baar andar wala loop 200 baar chalta hai: 500 x 200 = 100000. Tadaad zarb hoti hai, is liye bade ranges (10000 x 10000 = 100,000,000) par program bohat sust ho jata hai: performance bottleneck.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, the total number of executions becomes:

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between cProfile and timeit.
(cProfile aur timeit mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono profiling modules ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: cProfile generates a profiling report that shows how much time each function takes during program execution.

rows: Profiling report banata hai.
Execution time napta aur compare karta hai.
Dikhata hai ke program chalte waqt har function kitna waqt leta hai.
Sust aur tez code ka execution time compare karta hai.
Misal: cProfile.run("main()")
Misal: timeit.timeit(lambda: slow_sum(numbers), number=10)

blocks.prompt:
30 What is a performance bottleneck? Name three ways to fix it.
(Performance bottleneck kya hai? Ise theek karne ke teen tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Performance bottleneck code ka woh hissa hai jo program ko sust karta hai. Ise behtar algorithms, ghair zaroori operations kam kar ke, ya efficient data structures istemal kar ke theek kiya ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Optimization techniques include improving algorithms, reducing unnecessary operations, or using efficient data structures.

blocks.prompt:
31 Why is slow_sum() slower than fast_sum() although both give the same result?
(slow_sum() fast_sum() se sust kyun hai jabke dono ka nateeja aik hai?)
blocks.explanation: slow_sum() loop mein aik aik number khud jodta hai, jabke fast_sum() Python ka built-in sum() istemal karta hai jo pehle se optimised hai. 1 se 999999 ki list par dono 499999500000 dete hain.

book_ref.quote: slow_sum() is slower because it adds numbers manually using a loop.

blocks.prompt:
32 How is the bottleneck identified from a profiling report?
(Profiling report se bottleneck kaise pehchana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Report har function ka waqt dikhati hai; jo function zyada execution time le woh bottleneck hai. Misal mein slow_sum() fast_sum() se zyada waqt leta hai, is liye slow_sum() bottleneck hai.

book_ref.quote: The function taking more execution time is called the bottleneck.

blocks.prompt:
33 Why should performance be measured before optimizing a program?
(Program optimise karne se pehle performance kyun napni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Profiling tools har function ka execution time aur memory ka istemal napte aur batate hain ke kaun se hisse sust ya bhari hain. Pehle napne se optimization ki tarjeeh tay hoti hai aur mehnat asal bottlenecks par lagti hai.

book_ref.quote: Measuring performance helps prioritize areas for optimization.
